```{r}
#| label: setup

library(here)

source(
  here::here("R/___setup_project___.R")
)

# --- Tunables (overridden by Quarto params when passed) -------
minimum_taxonomic_records <-
  base::as.integer(
    params$minimum_taxonomic_records
  )

maximum_pages <- params$maximum_pages

trait_domain_filter <- params$trait_domain_filter
# --------------------------------------------------------------

graphical_options <-
  load_active_config_value("graphical")

# Path to the manual corrections file.
path_trait_corrections <-
  here::here("Data/Input/trait_manual_corrections.csv")

# Target store for the traits pipeline.
path_trait_store <-
  here::here(
    "Data/targets/traits_reference_reference/pipeline_traits_reference"
  )

#--- Load QC report -------------------------------------------
trait_quality_control_report_paths <-
  fs::dir_ls(
    here::here("Data/Temp"),
    regexp = "trait_qc_report_\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\.csv$"
  )

if (
  base::length(trait_quality_control_report_paths) == 0L
) {
  cli::cli_abort(
    c(
      "No trait_qc_report_*.csv found in Data/Temp/.",
      "i" = "Run the traits pipeline to generate it."
    )
  )
}

path_trait_quality_control_report <-
  trait_quality_control_report_paths |>
  base::sort() |>
  utils::tail(1L)

data_trait_quality_control_report <-
  readr::read_csv(
    path_trait_quality_control_report,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    outlier_fraction = .data[["n_suspected_outliers_taxon"]] /
      .data[["n_records"]]
  )

#--- Load raw trait values ------------------------------------
if (
  !fs::dir_exists(path_trait_store)
) {
  cli::cli_abort(
    c(
      "Traits target store not found at: {path_trait_store}",
      "i" = "Run the traits pipeline first."
    )
  )
}

data_traits_raw <-
  targets::tar_read(
    data_traits_raw,
    store = path_trait_store
  )

data_taxon_classification <-
  targets::tar_read(
    data_combined_classification_table_traits,
    store = path_trait_store
  )

#--- Load corrections file ------------------------------------
if (
  base::file.exists(path_trait_corrections)
) {
  data_corrections_current <-
    readr::read_csv(
      path_trait_corrections,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
} else {
  data_corrections_current <-
    tibble::tibble(
      taxon_name = base::character(0L),
      trait_domain_name = base::character(0L)
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: prepare-data

# ----- Quality-control recommendation function ---------------
recommend_trait_quality_control_action <- function(
    record_count,
    outlier_fraction,
    outlier_count,
    interquartile_range,
    mean_median_ratio,
    outlier_direction) {
  recommendation_result <-
    dplyr::case_when(
      interquartile_range == 0 ~
        base::list(
          label = "ZERO-IQR",
          colour = "#2166ac",
          suggestion = "Values identical; artefact likely"
        ),
      record_count <= 5L ~
        base::list(
          label = "SMALL SAMPLE",
          colour = "#999999",
          suggestion = "Too few records to assess"
        ),
      mean_median_ratio >= 5 & outlier_direction != "MIXED" ~
        base::list(
          label = "SCALE ISSUE",
          colour = "#d73027",
          suggestion = stringr::str_glue(
            "scale_factor = {
              1 / 10^base::round(base::log10(mean_median_ratio))
            }"
          )
        ),
      outlier_fraction >= 0.5 ~
        base::list(
          label = "HIGH FRACTION",
          colour = "#d73027",
          suggestion = "Consider exclude"
        ),
      outlier_fraction < 0.1 &
        outlier_count == 1L &
        record_count >= 10L ~
        base::list(
          label = "PROBABLY OK",
          colour = "#1a9641",
          suggestion = "Single outlier in large sample"
        ),
      .default =
        base::list(
          label = "REVIEW",
          colour = "#f46d43",
          suggestion = "Manual review required"
        )
    )
  return(recommendation_result)
}

# ----- Compute derived columns --------------------------------
data_flagged_trait_groups <-
  data_trait_quality_control_report |>
  dplyr::filter(.data[["n_suspected_outliers_taxon"]] > 0L) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_median_ratio = dplyr::if_else(
      .data[["median"]] > 0,
      .data[["mean"]] / .data[["median"]],
      NA_real_
    ),
    cv_pct = dplyr::if_else(
      .data[["mean"]] > 0,
      .data[["sd"]] / .data[["mean"]] * 100,
      NA_real_
    ),
    priority_score =
      .data[["outlier_fraction"]] *
        base::log10(.data[["n_records"]] + 1)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    data_corrections_current |>
      dplyr::select(
        "taxon_name",
        "trait_domain_name"
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(already_corrected = TRUE),
    by = dplyr::join_by(taxon_name, trait_domain_name)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    already_corrected = tidyr::replace_na(.data[["already_corrected"]], FALSE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data[["trait_domain_name"]],
    dplyr::desc(.data[["priority_score"]])
  )

# Apply domain filter.
if (
  !base::is.null(trait_domain_filter)
) {
  data_flagged_trait_groups <-
    data_flagged_trait_groups |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data[["trait_domain_name"]] == trait_domain_filter
    )
}

# Apply page cap.
if (
  !base::is.null(maximum_pages)
) {
  data_flagged_trait_groups <-
    data_flagged_trait_groups |>
    utils::head(maximum_pages)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: generate-pages
#| results: 'asis'

base::set.seed(900723)

trait_domains <-
  data_flagged_trait_groups |>
  dplyr::pull(.data[["trait_domain_name"]]) |>
  base::unique()

render_trait_quality_control_row <- function(
    row_index,
    data_trait_domain,
    trait_domain) {
  data_row <-
    data_trait_domain |>
    dplyr::slice(row_index)

focal_taxon <-
  data_row |>
  dplyr::pull(.data[["taxon_name"]])

record_count <-
  data_row |>
  dplyr::pull(.data[["n_records"]])

outlier_count <-
  data_row |>
  dplyr::pull(.data[["n_suspected_outliers_taxon"]]) |>
  base::as.integer()

outlier_fraction <-
  data_row |>
  dplyr::pull(.data[["outlier_fraction"]])

interquartile_range <-
  data_row |>
  dplyr::pull(.data[["IQR"]])

mean_median_ratio <-
  data_row |>
  dplyr::pull(.data[["mean_median_ratio"]])

coefficient_of_variation <-
  data_row |>
  dplyr::pull(.data[["cv_pct"]])

priority_score <-
  data_row |>
  dplyr::pull(.data[["priority_score"]])

already_corrected <-
  data_row |>
  dplyr::pull(.data[["already_corrected"]])

# Outlier direction (ALL HIGH / ALL LOW / MIXED).
data_focal_trait_records <-
  data_traits_raw |>
  dplyr::filter(
    .data[["taxon_name"]] == focal_taxon,
    .data[["trait_domain_name"]] == trait_domain
  )

data_focal_trait_summary <-
  data_row |>
  dplyr::select(
    "mean",
    "median",
    "IQR",
    "sd",
    "n_records",
    "n_suspected_outliers_taxon",
    "outlier_fraction"
  )

trait_values <-
  data_focal_trait_records |>
  dplyr::pull(.data[["trait_value"]])

lower_quartile <-
  stats::quantile(trait_values, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)

upper_quartile <-
  stats::quantile(trait_values, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

focal_interquartile_range <-
  base::unname(upper_quartile - lower_quartile)

upper_fence <-
  base::unname(upper_quartile + 1.5 * focal_interquartile_range)

lower_fence <-
  base::unname(lower_quartile - 1.5 * focal_interquartile_range)

outlier_values <-
  trait_values[trait_values > upper_fence | trait_values < lower_fence]

outlier_direction <-
  dplyr::case_when(
    base::all(outlier_values > upper_fence) ~ "ALL HIGH",
    base::all(outlier_values < lower_fence) ~ "ALL LOW",
    .default = "MIXED"
  )

# Heuristic recommendation.
quality_control_recommendation <-
  recommend_trait_quality_control_action(
    record_count = record_count,
    outlier_fraction = outlier_fraction,
    outlier_count = outlier_count,
    interquartile_range = interquartile_range,
    mean_median_ratio = mean_median_ratio,
    outlier_direction = outlier_direction
  )

recommendation_label <-
  purrr::chuck(quality_control_recommendation, "label")

recommendation_colour <-
  purrr::chuck(quality_control_recommendation, "colour")

recommendation_suggestion <-
  purrr::chuck(quality_control_recommendation, "suggestion")

# ---- Plot: raw distribution -------------------------
plot_focal_distribution <-
  plot_focal_trait_distribution(
    data_focal_trait_records = data_focal_trait_records,
    data_focal_trait_summary = data_focal_trait_summary,
    focal_taxon = focal_taxon,
    trait_domain = trait_domain,
    graphical_options = graphical_options,
    verbose = FALSE
  )

# ---- Plot: taxonomic comparison ------------------------
data_taxonomic_trait_summary <-
  summarise_taxonomic_group_traits(
    data_trait_records = data_traits_raw,
    data_taxon_classification = data_taxon_classification,
    focal_taxon = focal_taxon,
    trait_domain = trait_domain,
    taxonomic_rank = "family",
    verbose = FALSE
  )

plot_taxonomic_comparison <-
  plot_taxonomic_trait_comparison(
    data_taxonomic_trait_summary = data_taxonomic_trait_summary,
    data_focal_trait_summary = data_focal_trait_summary,
    focal_taxon = focal_taxon,
    trait_domain = trait_domain,
    minimum_records = minimum_taxonomic_records,
    graphical_options = graphical_options,
    verbose = FALSE
  )

# ---- Panel: stats + heuristic label -----------------
corrected_text <-
  dplyr::if_else(
    already_corrected,
    "YES  [already corrected]",
    "no"
  )

outlier_percentage <-
  base::round(outlier_fraction * 100, 1)

stats_text <-
  stringr::str_glue(
    "n = {record_count}  |  ",
    "outliers = {outlier_count} ({outlier_percentage}%)  |  ",
    "direction = {outlier_direction}  |  ",
    "CV = {base::round(coefficient_of_variation, 1)}%  |  ",
    "mean/median = {base::round(mean_median_ratio, 2)}  |  ",
    "priority = {base::round(priority_score, 3)}  |  ",
    "corrected = {corrected_text}"
  )

plot_quality_control_summary <-
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::xlim(0, 1) +
  ggplot2::ylim(0, 1) +
  ggplot2::theme_void() +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = recommendation_colour,
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.65,
    label = recommendation_label,
    size = 7,
    fontface = "bold",
    colour = recommendation_colour
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.35,
    label = recommendation_suggestion,
    size = 4,
    colour = "grey30"
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.1,
    label = stats_text,
    size = 3,
    colour = "grey40"
  )

# ---- Compose with patchwork -------------------------
# wrap_plots() avoids S7 operator dispatch issues that
#   arise when combining ggview-classed plots with | .
plot_comparison_row <-
  patchwork::wrap_plots(
    plot_focal_distribution, plot_taxonomic_comparison,
    ncol = 2L
  )

plot_quality_control_review <-
  plot_comparison_row /
  plot_quality_control_summary +
  patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(0.70, 0.30)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = stringr::str_glue(
      "{focal_taxon}  \u2014  {trait_domain}"
    ),
    subtitle = stringr::str_glue(
      "Heuristic: {recommendation_label}  |  Suggestion: {recommendation_suggestion}"
    ),
    theme = ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 14,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 10,
        colour = recommendation_colour
      )
    )
  )

  base::print(plot_quality_control_review)

  base::cat("\n\n\\newpage\n\n")
}

render_trait_quality_control_domain <- function(trait_domain) {
  base::cat(
    stringr::str_glue("\n\n## {trait_domain}\n\n")
  )

  data_trait_domain <-
    data_flagged_trait_groups |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data[["trait_domain_name"]] == trait_domain
    )

  purrr::walk(
    .x = base::seq_len(base::nrow(data_trait_domain)),
    .f = render_trait_quality_control_row,
    data_trait_domain = data_trait_domain,
    trait_domain = trait_domain
  )

  return(base::invisible(NULL))
}

purrr::walk(
  .x = trait_domains,
  .f = render_trait_quality_control_domain
)
```
